requirements.expected_invariant: Each material statement has accepted-source evidence AND is entailed; valid citation syntax is insufficient.
requirements.counterexample: Invented assertion with a real but unrelated citation; reject it.

requirements.expected_invariant: Verbatim quotations equal the accepted source span; raw-audio track independently checks whether that transcript is correct.
requirements.counterexample: Change not to yes, amount, date, speaker, recording or span; veto material corruption.

requirements.expected_invariant: Preserve both contradictory statements, their order and any explicit correction; distinguish unknown from negative and N/A.
requirements.counterexample: Early 50k budget, later corrected 15k; report correction, not convenient selection.

requirements.expected_invariant: Purpose, role, medium and sequence are separate; setter success need not be purchase; no invented prior-call continuity.
requirements.counterexample: Short appointment setter, follow-up without prior audio, discovery-only Zoom; no absent-close penalty.

requirements.expected_invariant: Competing plausible explanations and the smallest useful clarification; no unsupported affordability or deception claim.
requirements.counterexample: Price is high versus no price concern; wife/partner approval versus excuse assumption.

requirements.expected_invariant: Discovery/solution relevance evaluated in context; no rigid checklist, fixed minute or mandatory pain manufacturing.
requirements.counterexample: A requested short product overview is not automatically a premature full pitch.

requirements.requirement: Grounded values, ethical guidance and outcome truth
requirements.expected_invariant: Separate stated/estimated/unknown values; conditional commitment is not completed sale; no fabricated urgency, ROI or coercion.
requirements.counterexample: If partner agrees I will buy, explicit stop/no, unquantified impact; no won/revenue/probability invention.

requirements.expected_invariant: No visual assertions from audio or measured delivery claims from transcript alone; gaps lower confidence.
requirements.counterexample: Audio-only Zoom pause and unavailable beginning of call; do not invent eye contact or poor opening.

requirements.requirement: Specific reinforcement, prioritized correction, one mission
requirements.expected_invariant: Identify a real strength; choose a consequential supported correction; give a feasible observable next-call mission or explicit insufficient evidence.
requirements.counterexample: Upstream diagnostic gap outranks a trivial phrase; suggested dialogue is not quoted source.

requirements.expected_invariant: No persistent learner, recurrence, mastery or multi-call inference without implemented authorized evidence.
requirements.counterexample: Single good call must not produce mastery; single bad call must not produce recurring weakness.

requirements.requirement: Grounded prospect facts and separated advice
requirements.expected_invariant: Prospect statements, salesperson statements, inferred context and proposed deal actions remain distinct; no invented contact/budget/stakeholder facts.
requirements.counterexample: Salesperson suggests a 100k target; do not record it as the prospect's declared goal.

prompt_only.vary_only: Brain/prompt revision including its natural input-token cost; do not pad prompts to hide overhead.
prompt_only.baseline_preservation: Never rewrite original production reports/prompts. New baseline replay is a new benchmark artifact linked to the old prompt hash.
prompt_only.schema_preflight: Use an identical benchmark envelope supported by BOTH packs and score the shared content contract. If making the old pack fit requires semantic prompt edits, mark comparison bundled/non-pure; do not claim isolated Brain improvement. Candidate-only fields evaluated separately against gold.
prompt_only.language_preflight: Pure pairs require a report language both packs actually support. If legacy supports only Hindi+English, isolate prompt effect there across input languages; v4 English/Marathi get absolute gold evaluation and bundled product evaluation, not a fake matched legacy language claim.
prompt_only.historical_model_unavailable: Old saved artifacts remain observational baseline. Old prompt on a current common model is a counterfactual replay, not exact historical production reproduction.
prompt_only.verbosity: Same task scope/output budget/common deterministic reader; no truncation or LLM rewriting of one side. Log tokens, words/characters and reading time. Judge actionable correctness, not number of sections; length-stratified sensitivity is secondary.

audio_to_report.native_product: Compare actual native reports/UI separately to prompt-only common-content experiment; do not attribute bundled differences solely to the Brain.

mandatory_features: Actually confirmed sale without probability invention
At least two distinct non-padded 60m scenarios per source language in holdout

real_calls_gate: Documented participant consent and evaluation use
No raw transcript/audio/gold text in Git

Holdout cross-output coverage can use predeclared 9 families (one per input-language x duration cell), 18 extra v4 renders. These need separate funding and are not extra independent N.
corpus.retained_hour_fixture: Previously retained synthetic artifacts may be used only for protocol plumbing until independently qualified for the corpus; no retained operational fixture details are published.

rubric.purpose: Internal report-quality evaluation only; never salesperson grade, access decision or mastery score.

anchors.0: Materially false, harmful, unusable or unsupported.
anchors.2: Partly useful but substantive omissions, generic advice or language repair needed.
anchors.3: Accurate, specific, actionable and readable; only minor edits needed.
anchors.4: Unusually clear and context-sensitive; precise evidence and economical advice with no material repair.

rubric.ratings: Assign each applicable dimension separately; N/A has a reason. No weighted salesperson score.

reviewers.sales: An appointed lead sales reviewer and an independent qualified sales reviewer, blind to arm/model/cost; neither alone determines preference.
reviewers.language: Input/output-language competent reviewer; Hindi and Marathi require distinct linguistic competence.
reviewers.adjudication: A third qualified human resolves disagreements; preserve initial ratings. No reviewer automatically overrides stylistic preferences.
reviewers.auxiliary: Non-generator model when already approved; human decisions remain primary. Separate calibration split, no provider call in this packet.

auxiliary_calibration.failure_behavior: disable model-judge influence, keep manual human review; no new credentials required

rubric.blinding: Randomized left/right per reviewer, stable within session; identity and costs hidden until ratings locked. Source audio and evidence accessible. Identical reader/typography for content track; actual UI evaluated separately.
rubric.tie: Both materially equivalent on correctness and practical next-call usefulness, irrespective of length/style.
rubric.abstain: Evidence, language competence or comparability insufficient. Explain reason; never silently map abstain to tie.
rubric.gold: Facts, evidence spans, critical facts, allowed interpretations, forbidden claims and acceptable mission properties, not a single ideal report. Sealed gold is judge-only and never concatenated into a generator prompt.
veto_errors: Wrong material identity, amount, date or commitment
Conditional yes reported as actual sale
Fabricated source quotation or wrong-source citation
Unsupported factual motive/affordability/deception assertion that changes interpretation
Full-coverage or visual claim unsupported by supplied modality
Missing critical safety/decision correction in gold
rubric.claim_denominators: Deduplicate semantic claims before computing precision; no inflation with repeated/trivial assertions. All material claims reviewed, not only selected favorable citations. Critical gold facts and corrected decision context cannot be diluted by many easy facts.

statistics.status: provisional thresholds require owner approval before provider spending; no achieved result
statistics.target_population: Predeclared balanced benchmark mixture, not all production traffic; traffic-weighted estimate later needs actual weights.
statistics.unit: One independent call/scenario family. Sections, reviewer votes, translations, noise variants and repeated generations are not extra N.
statistics.primary_endpoint: Consensus paired usefulness preference y=1 candidate, -1 baseline, 0 tie, null abstain; delta=(wins-losses)/evaluable families.
statistics.primary_render: One preselected generation and common report language per family for prompt-only; additional languages/replicates are secondary cluster data, not best-of selection.
statistics.confidence_interval: 10000 paired call-family bootstrap draws, stratified by source language x duration in holdout; fixed seed 20260923. If degeneracy makes bootstrap unrealistically narrow, report conservative bounded-variable interval as well and use wider gate interval.
statistics.bounded_fallback_interval: For independent y in [-1,1], use clipped mean +/- sqrt(2*ln(2/alpha)/N) (Hoeffding) as conservative degeneracy fallback; do not claim narrow uncertainty from all ties or all wins in a tiny sample.

superiority.interpretation: 15 additional useful preferences per 100 calls is a proposed worthwhile gain; owner may change only before seeing results.

subgroup_no_regression.every_intersection: show all 9 source-language x duration cells and errors; n=4 cells are descriptive, no significance claim
subgroup_no_regression.failure: any violation or insufficient precision -> reject or inconclusive for that scope; do not hide under aggregate win

cost_optimization.quality_reference: quality-qualified v4 reference, not an invalid cheap baseline
cost_optimization.latency: provisional interactive p95 <= 1.20x matched reference plus existing timeout constraints; inspect failures/censored times separately; owner latency SLO remains to approve

statistics.missingness: Primary CI on evaluable calls plus worst-case abstention sensitivity [(W-L-A)/N,(W-L+A)/N]. If missingness could reverse decision, inconclusive.
statistics.screening: Read results only at batches 6,12,18 per evaluated arm; safety/quality floor elimination, no inferential significance claims; freeze selection rule before first output.
statistics.holdout: One final locked v4 configuration vs frozen baseline, once after all 36 families and reviews. No optional stopping/peeking except safety stop. If inconclusive, no silent sample extension; any next experiment requires separately approved new protocol and unused holdout.
statistics.multiplicity: Choose one primary comparison before unsealing. Multiple paid holdout comparisons require predeclared multiplicity control, not best p-value selection.
statistics.zero_event_caveat: 0 severe errors/36 calls has one-sided 95% binomial upper bound 1-0.05^(1/36) ~= 7.98%; about 299 independent zero-error calls needed for <1%. Synthetic challenge-set results are not population guarantees.
statistics.failure_handling: All scheduled comparable logical jobs remain in acceptance/cost denominators. Invalid candidate vs valid baseline is a candidate loss, not abstention; vice versa for baseline. Both invalid produce no acceptable report and fail the acceptance floor, not a favorable tie. Deliberate unprocessable safety fixtures are a separately declared control set, not removed from holdout after seeing failures.
statistics.severe_gate_scope: Any severe factual error in an accepted/customer-visible report vetoes the arm. Rejected prepublication attempts remain counted as first-pass failures, with their severe defects and costs reported; successful repair must not erase those records. Track first-pass and final quality separately.

phases.deliver: Harness, source/rule manifest, sealed gold, rate-card resolver, sanitized usage adapters, blind read-only comparator, append-only events and deterministic fixtures. Import retained transcript/C4 only through authorized local paths.
phases.stop: No paid output or quality claim.

phases.vary: old versus v4 prompt only; no ASR/C4 rerun when compatible retained data exists
phases.replicates: Optional predeclared second renders on six families: up to 12 extra C5 calls, budget separately; no additional independent N.

phases.vary: One factor at a time: C5 model, then C4 model, chunk size, overlap, supported thinking, output budget, temperature. Controls and effective hashes pinned.
phases.cap: At most 8 additional single-factor configurations, each initially 6 families; freeze exact list and request counts in funding plan. Unsupported knobs skipped with reason, not silently ignored.
phases.eliminate: Any severe error or absolute quality-floor violation; survive on utility, cost and reliability, not provider marketing.

phases.design: At most one 2x2 interaction among two surviving factors; 6 stress-balanced screen families, maximum 24 logical reports before explicitly budgeted repairs.
phases.purpose: Check cheaper C4 x cheaper C5 or thinking x chunk-size interaction; no exhaustive grid.

phases.design: Freeze one finalist. Two pipelines x 36 sealed independent families; primary renders only.
phases.C4_requests: Compute from exact per-arm chunk plans, not an assumed constant five packets.
phases.optional_prompt_only_holdout: 2 x 36 additional C5 calls on same accepted inputs only when pure brain effect still needs confirmation; separately funded, not extra N.

search_controls.ready_requires: All stages and parameters needed for the arm; discovery is not qualification. No credentials or data-policy changes allowed to make an arm run.
max_c5_synthesis_options: Existing Gemini reference exact resolved model
search_controls.expensive_reference: gemini-3.1-pro-preview only as an already-authorized limited reference/fallback; do not run everywhere by default.
search_controls.temperature: Probe adapter serialization and actual provider support; do not invent knobs, assume 0 is best, or rely on seed for strict determinism.
search_controls.caching: Content-addressed nodes invalidate downstream on audio/transcript/evidence/context/prompt/schema/model/API/settings/language change. Fix cold/warm test policy and interleave pairs so cache/order does not favor an arm.

fallback.default: disabled in raw first-pass comparison; separately evaluate production fallback policy
fallback.scope: Choose one bounded repair OR approved expensive-model fallback, not both in a cascade. Existing lower ceilings always win.
triggers: Explicit structural/grounding validation failure or supported truncation diagnosis
Confirmed unused allowance and existing policy approval
not_triggers: Cheap model disliked its own answer
Insufficient source evidence that a larger model cannot create
fallback.billing_uncertain: Stop/reconcile before retry; append all failed/unknown attempts, never overwrite.

search_controls.opaque_retries: Disable uninstrumented SDK retries or expose every underlying provider request as its own attempt/receipt. One application call must not hide multiple charged provider attempts.

cost_contract.zero_rule: Only explicit zero/uncharged evidence is zero; null means unknown. Google documented 400/500 treatment can support estimated zero for matching errors, not missing responses or app-invalid 200 results.
cost_contract.token_accounting: Normalize mutually exclusive input_uncached, input_cached, output_visible and reasoning categories from actual endpoint semantics. If completion already includes reasoning, do not add it twice. Preserve provider raw numeric usage receipt privately, no reasoning text required.
cost_contract.per_unique_source_minute: Sum attributable all-attempt pipeline costs / (sum unique original source duration seconds per configuration / 60). Retries/channels/three views do not multiply the source denominator.
cost_contract.per_accepted_report: All attempted logical-job costs / count distinct runtime-accepted logical reports; additionally publish cost per quality-accepted report. Failed jobs stay in numerator; zero accepted means undefined, not zero.
cost_contract.reuse: Show incremental experiment spend separately from production-equivalent full-pipeline cost. A reused ASR/C4 has zero new cash call but retains cost provenance; do not double-book a shared receipt in actual experiment totals or pretend upstream production cost is zero.
infrastructure: Measured worker CPU/core-seconds or incremental compute rental
Scratch/memory only where marginal charge applies
Allocated VPS/infrastructure/subscription share with period and denominator
cost_contract.fixed_vs_variable: Allocate fixed monthly costs once; do not also charge the same VPS CPU as variable cost when it is only fixed. Included subscription quota is not permanently free; report marginal draw and amortized fixed cost separately.
cost_contract.rates: Snapshot provider endpoint/region/tier/channel/add-ons/data-use/discount/promo dates. No cross-provider aggregate dollar-per-token metric without token-category mix.
cost_contract.fx_tax: Store invoice currency, settlement FX/date/source/spread and nonrecoverable tax; unknown now. No invented INR exchange rate or tax rate.
cost_contract.unknown_total: If any material attempt cost is unknown, display known subtotal + unknown count and separately labeled reservation/range, not complete actual total.
cost_contract.profit: Net revenue excluding pass-through taxes and after discounts/refunds minus variable pipeline/payment/refund fees/support/acquisition allocations. Net revenue/fees/support are unknown here; no profitable configuration can yet be claimed.
cost_contract.pareto: First hard quality/reliability/language floors, then full cost and latency uncertainty. A cheap invalid result is dominated regardless of token price.

budget_template.formula: B_stage = sum over every planned attempt (ASR_upper + C4_upper + C5_upper + repair/fallback_upper + judge_upper + infra_upper) + nonrecoverable tax/FX fees. Compare known spend + retained uncertain reservations + prospective request upper bound <= stage and global caps atomically.
budget_template.expected_not_cap: Observed/pilot usage supports expected estimate; ceilings only support upper bound. Never report a ceiling as actual usage.

illustration_only.not_included: Infrastructure, add-ons, retries, discounts, subscription allocation, tax and FX; not a run or invoice.

budget_template.review_labor: Provider credits are not total experiment cost. Plan curator/actor/reviewer hours and rates separately; currently unknown. Do not quote a token-only budget as the full cost of the experiment.
